speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Cups in a row. I want the board back before I have to go and find it.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: The boats are on the step. I am not bringing a hull in so a cup can be proud of itself.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Leave them out. A dark step can mind three boats without a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said I would not bring them in. I am still not bringing them in.
